title: Functions and whitespace
hints: The first failure is a panic while the package loads: a template can only call functions that were registered before Parse saw them.
Call Funcs on the new template before Parse: template.New("scores").Funcs(...).Parse(...). After that, the output has extra blank lines: every newline in the template text is copied into the output.
A minus sign inside the braces trims whitespace next to an action: {{- trims before it, -}} trims after it. Trim before range, before upper, and after end.
